items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: I think, though, when the Valkian went through their files that they did find some of them.

ctx.x: I understand that Columbia did not have the original presses of Bessie Smith. They had destroyed them all or thrown them away.

I think most of them had been, but I do think, though, when the Valkian went through their files that they did find some of them. I know they did find, like, the one at the Christmas ball. Were there two of those? Yeah, what was the other one? I can't think of the other one. So I think...
Unissued ones, is that what you did?
